decisions.reason: As an established 2023 multi-model line on its own page and very close to the firm’s core modular lighting offer, it is likely to be retained because sunk investment, public commitment and the option to view any weaker sales as temporary all favor persistence.

This newly launched spotlight line is close to the core business and prominently presented on its own page, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse a recent visible commitment in a growing market.

The multi-outlet ceiling canopy extends the firm’s established system offer and has its own page, making it a credible strategic complement that management is inclined to keep while giving the launch more time.

Although somewhat more specialized, the low-voltage multi-outlet canopy still builds directly on the firm’s modular lighting systems and has been publicly presented, so escalation of commitment points to retention for now.

The round glass track luminaires are close to the existing offer, but because they were only mentioned on the website rather than given a dedicated page, the public commitment is weaker and the withdrawal risk is higher, though management would still likely keep them for another year.
